Full market state in one call: prices, funding, fear/greed, positioning, liquidations

Peg deviation for a tokenized US equity on Solana: on-chain DEX price vs the underlying last real trade, in bps, with 24h stats split into market-open and off-hours. Sampled every 5 minutes by our own collector; this tape exists nowhere else.

Every tokenized US equity we track, ranked by off-hours peg risk: p95 and max deviation bps, market-open deviation as control, median liquidity. Dead pools are excluded rather than reported as perfect pegs.
